comparator: Require explicit model association; preserve stored table tokens and header units; absence is not a comparison pass.
native: Load, statics and compare remain refused pending a qualified adapter and approved manifest digest.
publication: Every input of a published model passes content inspection under public-rules-only authority. Without private inspection authority, inputs outside the two reviewed generic-name trees fail as publication-withheld. Models with failed, absent or unknown dependencies are excluded; exclusions are counts only.
validator: Record every YAML-validator failure; structural validation does not establish conversion fidelity or native loadability.
